tools.name: sonix_list_media
tools.description: List media files in the account, newest first, 100 per page. Filter by status, folder or name. Each item has id, name, duration, language, status and created_at. Sonix API: GET /v1/media.

tools.name: sonix_get_media
tools.description: Get one media file: name, duration, language, video flag, status (preparing, transcribing, aligning, completed, blocked, failed, duplicate), folder and public_url. Check status is completed before reading transcripts. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_list_shares
tools.description: List the users a media file is shared with, and whether each can edit it. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/shares.

tools.name: sonix_get_transcript_text
tools.description: Get the plain-text transcript of a completed media file, with speaker names and timestamps. Pass language to read a translation. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.

tools.name: sonix_get_captions
tools.description: Get a completed media file as SRT or VTT subtitles. Limit line length with limit_captions, max_characters and max_duration (limit_captions must be true for these). Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.srt or .vtt.

tools.name: sonix_get_transcript_json
tools.description: Get a completed transcript as JSON: speakers, and start and end times for each word. Pass language to read a translation. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/transcript.json.

tools.name: sonix_list_translations
tools.description: List the languages a media file was translated into, newest request first, with each status. Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/translations.

tools.name: sonix_get_translation
tools.description: Get the status of one translation (queued, translating, completed or failed). Sonix API: GET /v1/media/{id}/translations/{language}.

tools.name: sonix_get_export
tools.description: Get the status of a media export (processing or completed) and, when completed, its file_url. Sonix API: GET /v1/media_exports/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_get_burn_in
tools.description: Get the status (processing, completed or failed) and download url of a subtitled video. Sonix API: GET /v1/video_burn_ins/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_get_summarization
tools.description: Get an AI summarization by id: status (processing or completed), subtype, and the summary text. Sonix API: GET /v1/summarizations/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_list_folders
tools.description: List the folders of the account with their access control and restricted users. Use a folder id with sonix_list_media or sonix_upload_media. Sonix API: GET /v1/folders.

tools.name: sonix_list_batch_summarizations
tools.description: List the batch summarizations run on a folder, with status and created time. Sonix API: GET /v1/folders/{id}/batch_summarizations.

tools.name: sonix_get_batch_summarization
tools.description: Get one batch summarization: status (processing, completed or failed), the prompt, and the summaries. Sonix API: GET /v1/batch_summarizations/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_upload_media
tools.description: Start transcription of an audio or video file at a public URL (file_url). Uses transcription minutes of the account. For several spoken languages, set language to multi and list them in language_hints. Sonix API: POST /v1/media.

tools.name: sonix_update_media
tools.description: Change the name, custom label or folder of a media file. Only the given fields change. Sonix API: PUT /v1/media/{id}.

tools.name: sonix_create_export
tools.description: Export a completed media file as mp3, wav or mp4 (mp4 only for video). Highlights only by default; set remove_strikethrough to drop struck text. Returns an export id; read it with sonix_get_export. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/media_exports.

tools.name: sonix_create_translation
tools.description: Start a translation of a completed transcript into one language. Track it with sonix_get_translation. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/translations.

tools.name: sonix_create_summarization
tools.description: Start an AI summary, chapter list, sentiment, topic or entity analysis, or a custom prompt on a completed media file. Subtype custom needs prompt. Track it with sonix_get_summarization. Sonix API: POST /v1/media/{id}/summarizations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sonix_get_media, sonix_get_transcript_text, sonix_get_captions, sonix_get_transcript_json, sonix_get_burn_in, sonix_upload_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_summarization · Private data: sonix_list_media, sonix_get_media, sonix_list_shares, sonix_get_transcript_text, sonix_get_captions, sonix_list_translations, sonix_upload_media, sonix_update_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_summarization · Public sink: sonix_upload_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_translation, sonix_create_summarization · Destructive: sonix_list_batch_summarizations, sonix_create_export.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sonix_get_media, sonix_get_transcript_text, sonix_get_captions, sonix_get_transcript_json, sonix_get_burn_in, sonix_upload_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_summarization · Private data: sonix_list_media, sonix_get_media, sonix_list_shares, sonix_get_transcript_text, sonix_get_captions, sonix_list_translations, sonix_upload_media, sonix_update_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_summarization · Public sink: sonix_upload_media, sonix_create_export, sonix_create_translation, sonix_create_summarization · Destructive: sonix_list_batch_summarizations, sonix_create_export

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
